context:
Goal: a decision or a debt shows every file it governs, so an edit to any of them shows the record (your 268 note).
Problem (rule): the shared map lists code files only. In banchi, 8 non-code files (icons, the web manifest, an onnx model, the STE licence) lost 19 decision hints, and every repo on the shared map has the same gap for its non-code files.
Based on (ruling): 268 none (11:22 CST Nov 6): "fix our shared map too so that way the map can show files under a prose thing like a decision (or a debt etc)". Asked again to fix the scope of that change before a lane starts.
Based on (read): map-show takes a decision id since #1264 (map-show finds a decision's files); it can list only the files the map holds, which are code files.
Departs from: the shared map, which lists code files only — a lists each file a decision or debt names, code or not; b maps banchi's 8 files only.

Not blocking: banchi #1064 merges either way.
home: banchi docs/debts notes; claude-settings skill plain-english-map
lastAnswer: none (12:52 CST Nov 6): "'icon, a model, a licence or a config file' why is it specifically only these items?". Answered 13:00 CST in the reply; asked again.

options.gain: In every repo, an edit to an icon, a model, a licence or a config file shows the decisions and debts that govern it. banchi gets its 19 hints back.
options.label: Yes: list every file a decision or debt names
options.lose: One claude-settings lane on the shared map. The map grows by each non-code file a record names.

options.label: banchi only: map its 8 files
options.lose: Other repos keep the gap. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.

options.label: Accept the loss
options.lose: An edit to those files shows no decision; other repos keep the gap.

reply: It isn't limited to those. They were only examples: they're the kinds of file banchi's 8 lost hints point at (icons, the web manifest, an onnx model, the STE licence). Option a covers every file a decision or debt names, whatever its type: images, data, models, licences, config, anything. b would fix only banchi's 8. c leaves the gap.
title: Should the shared map list every file a decision or debt names, not only code files?
why: Recommended: a. It is the fix your note asks for, in the shared tool, so every repo gets it.
